entities.summary: Aliaksei Uladzimiravich Protas is a Belarusian professional ice hockey player who is a forward for the Washington Capitals of the National Hockey League (NHL). Protas previously played two seasons of major junior for the Prince Albert Raiders of the Western Hockey League (WHL), and was selected 91st overall by the Washington Capitals in the 2019 NHL entry draft. He made his professional debut in 2020 with Dinamo Minsk of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). Internationally, Protas has played for the Belarusian national junior team at two World Junior Championships.
